svg.title: Requests move from a queue to two execution slots
svg.desc: Two single requests dispatch immediately. Two groups of three arrive while both slots are occupied, then dispatch as Handler batches of four and two. In-process, in-memory batching. Pending requests do not survive process failure.

g.text: Each Handler batch holds one execution slot until it completes.
Illustrative timing · conveyor motion adds no collection window

text.tspan: Two execution slots are available. No requests, no work to dispatch.
The loop acquires slot A and dispatches request 01. BatchSize is a maximum, not a target.
The loop acquires slot B and dispatches request 02 while the first Handler batch is still running.

g.text: Two groups arrive. Both slots are occupied.

text.tspan: 03–05 arrive together, followed by 06–08. All six queue until an execution slot is available.

g.text: A slot is released. Four go together.

text.tspan: After 01 completes, the loop acquires slot A and pulls 03–06. Arrival groups need not match Handler batches.
After 02 completes, the loop acquires slot B and pulls 07–08 without waiting to fill a batch.

g.text: Batches can finish out of order

text.tspan: The later two-request batch finishes first. The four-request batch still holds slot A.
Every request has its result. Batch sizes were 1, 1, 4, and 2. Ready for the next arrivals.

g.text: A slot is released. Four go together.

text.tspan: After 01 completes, the loop acquires slot A and pulls 03–06. Arrival groups need not match Handler batches.

svg.text: In-process, in-memory batching. Pending requests do not survive process failure.
